page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES cryptography. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average capabilities across most standard workloads. The instance achieves middle-tier results in multi-core CPU stress tests, memory bandwidth (reaching 48.91 GB/sec for uncached large block reads), and Passmark CPU and memory evaluations. Database operations and Redis SET operations also perform in the average range, with Redis handling 6.4 million operations per second. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by bottom-quartile results in single-threaded gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and static web serving throughput.

Given its dedicated hardware profile and balanced resource allocation, the ecs.g6.2xlarge offers a stable, predictable environment for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, software compilation, text processing, and Redis caching. However, it may not be the most cost-efficient option for workloads requiring high-throughput static web serving or intensive single-threaded compression due to its lower performance in those specific areas.
